CAPABILITY CATALOG // SYS-06

Architectural Capabilities & Deliverables

Specific technical interventions, deployment baselines, and governance deliverables included in this practice.

Zero-Touch Automated Provisioning

Integration with Apple Business Manager (ABM), Android Enterprise Zero-Touch, and Windows Autopilot to deliver corporate-ready hardware directly to users without IT unboxing.

BYOD Containerization (MAM)

Mobile Application Management without enrollment, isolating corporate Outlook, Teams, and OneDrive files inside an encrypted sandbox while preserving personal privacy on employee-owned phones.

Conditional Access Posture Checks

Blocking authentication requests from devices that fail compliance benchmarks (outdated OS versions, disabled screen lock passcodes, detected root/jailbreak, or missing disk encryption).

Selective & Full Remote Wipe

Instant cryptographic erasure of corporate credentials and cached files upon employee termination or lost device report, without touching personal photos or apps.

Automated Certificate & Wi-Fi Push

Seamless distribution of enterprise 802.1X certificates, always-on VPN configuration profiles, and corporate Wi-Fi credentials without exposing passwords to end users.

Kiosk & Single-App Lock Mode

Locking warehouse handhelds, retail POS tablets, and healthcare check-in terminals into single-app kiosk modes preventing user tampering and unauthorized web browsing.

PROVEN FIELD EXECUTION // CASE STUDY

Legal Practice: Air-Gapping Client Records on Mobile Devices

The Challenge

A Central Florida legal firm had 45 attorneys accessing confidential litigation documents on personal iPhones and iPads without corporate encryption, risking severe client privilege breaches.

Engineering Solution

Steve Cormier deployed Microsoft Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM) with Conditional Access, enforced biometric FaceID unlock on corporate apps, disabled cut/copy/paste into personal apps, and enabled one-click corporate wipe.

Quantified Outcome

100% of confidential client documents air-gapped from personal apps, complete compliance with Florida Bar digital privacy guidelines, and zero loss of personal employee data.
